To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the latent feature representations of tracks and users are important for capturing general musical preferences and that hashtags can be leveraged to capture context-specific preferences.

(1) the affective information of a user can be captured by hashtags, (2) a user’s general and context-specific musical preferences can be captured by latent features of tracks and hashtags, respectively, and (3) the best performing ranking strategy is one that incorporates both the affective hashtags and latent features of users and tracks.

(1) hashtags are an important source of context information for music recommendations, (2) affective hashtags are a valuable source of context information, and (3) affective hashtags can be used to improve ranking methods that are based on user and track latent representations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to leverage affective information for music recommendation.
the question how the affective information in hashtags can be used to improve music recommendations and how the affective context of a user can be captured.
the question of whether and how affective hashtags can be leveraged to improve ranking of music recommendations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the latent features of tracks and hashtags are useful for capturing the general preferences of users, whereas hashtags and their affective information are useful for capturing more complex, context-specific musical preferences.
a ranking strategy that incorporates the latent features of users and tracks, as well as affective and hashtag information, performs the best.
affective hashtags can indeed be leveraged for improving music recommendation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
hashtags can indeed be used for ranking music recommendations, but the affective information contained in them has to be taken into account as well.
affective information and hashtags are useful for ranking music recommendations.
the latent features of hashtags and the affective information they contain can be leveraged to improve the quality of music recommendation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
hashtags are a useful source of information for music recommender systems and can be used to capture context-dependent musical preferences.
hashtags provide valuable information for music recommendation, especially when combined with affective information.

hashtags are a promising context source for capturing users’ emotional states and their music preferences.
